# Enny's Kitchen

> Home-cooked Nigerian food, freshly prepared in Surulere, Lagos. Orders are placed on WhatsApp.

## Pages

- Home: https://www.ennyskitchen.com/
- Menu and ordering: https://www.ennyskitchen.com/menu
- About the kitchen: https://www.ennyskitchen.com/about
- How to order, delivery, pickup and FAQs: https://www.ennyskitchen.com/how-to-order
- Contact: https://www.ennyskitchen.com/contact

## Food

The menu includes white rice, jollof rice, fried rice, beans, fried plantain, Egusi soup,
Efo Riro, Eba, Amala and chicken portions. Everything is made to order. Listed prices are a
guide; availability and the final total are confirmed on WhatsApp.

  Surulere, Lagos, Nigeria.
